core.revenue.title: Revenue
core.revenue.insight: Everything that came in through sales in the chosen period.

core.revenue_trend.title: Revenue Trend
core.revenue_trend.insight: The same revenue number plotted day by day, so you see the shape, not just the total.

core.net_profit.title: Net Profit
core.net_profit.insight: What is actually left after cost of goods and every expense.

core.profit_trend.title: Profit Trend
core.profit_trend.insight: Net profit day by day — shows whether good months are a habit or a fluke.

core.gross_profit.title: Gross Profit
core.gross_profit.insight: Sales minus what those goods cost you, before running expenses.

core.gross_margin_pct.title: Gross Margin %
core.gross_margin_pct.insight: How many paisa of every rupee of sales survives the cost of goods.

core.net_margin_pct.title: Net Margin %
core.net_margin_pct.insight: How many paisa of every rupee of sales you finally keep.

core.cogs.title: Cost of Goods Sold
core.cogs.insight: What the things you sold actually cost you to buy or make.

core.expenses_total.title: Total Expenses
core.expenses_total.insight: Every rupee spent on running the business in the period.

core.expense_ratio.title: Expense Ratio
core.expense_ratio.insight: Expenses as a share of revenue — the single fastest overspending alarm.

core.receivables.title: Receivables
core.receivables.insight: Money sitting with other people that belongs to you.

core.receivables_aging.title: Receivables Aging

core.payables.insight: Money you owe and have not paid yet.

core.payables_aging.title: Payables Aging
core.payables_aging.insight: What you owe, bucketed by how overdue it is.

core.total_liquidity.title: Total Liquidity
core.total_liquidity.insight: Cash in hand plus every bank balance — what you could pay out today.

core.liquidity_trend.title: Liquidity Trend
core.liquidity_trend.insight: Total liquidity plotted across the period, so you see whether you are building cash or bleeding it.

core.cash_flow_trend.title: Cash In vs Cash Out
core.cash_flow_trend.insight: Two lines: money arriving and money leaving, day by day.

core.net_cash_position.title: Net Cash Position
core.net_cash_position.insight: Liquidity minus what you owe — the honest version of 'how much do I have'.

core.working_capital.title: Working Capital
core.working_capital.insight: Current assets minus current liabilities. Room to breathe.

core.revenue_vs_prev.title: Revenue vs Last Period
core.revenue_vs_prev.insight: This period's revenue against the one before it, as a percentage.

core.profit_vs_prev.title: Profit vs Last Period
core.profit_vs_prev.insight: This period's profit against the one before it.

core.transaction_count.insight: How many documents of any kind were posted in the period.

core.avg_transaction_value.title: Average Transaction Value
core.avg_transaction_value.insight: Total value divided by number of transactions.

core.busiest_day.title: Busiest Day
core.busiest_day.insight: Which day of the period brought in the most money.

core.peak_hour.title: Peak Hour
core.peak_hour.insight: The hour of the day that consistently earns the most.

core.balance_sheet_ok.title: Books Balanced
core.balance_sheet_ok.insight: A live check that debits equal credits. Green means your numbers are arithmetically sound.

core.journal_entries_count.title: Journal Entries Posted
core.journal_entries_count.insight: How many double-entry rows the ledger engine wrote for you automatically.

core.audit_trail_count.title: Audit Events Logged
core.audit_trail_count.insight: Every change anyone made, counted. Nothing happens without a record.

core.reversal_count.title: Reversals & Corrections
core.reversal_count.insight: How many entries had to be reversed — a quiet measure of data discipline.

core.document_sequence_ok.title: Document Numbering Intact
core.document_sequence_ok.insight: Confirms no invoice or bill number is missing or duplicated.

core.user_activity.title: Active Users
core.user_activity.insight: Who has actually logged in and worked today.

core.plan_usage.title: Plan Usage
core.plan_usage.insight: How much of your plan's limits you have used this cycle.

products.catalogue_value.title: Catalogue Value

products.top_margin.insight: The products that earn you the most per unit sold.

products.lowest_margin.title: Thinnest-Margin Products
products.lowest_margin.insight: Products you sell a lot of but barely earn on.

products.never_sold.title: Products Never Sold
products.never_sold.insight: Items sitting in the catalogue that nobody has ever bought.

products.missing_cost.title: Products Missing a Cost

products.new_this_period.title: Products Added
products.new_this_period.insight: New items added to the catalogue in the period.

services.top_services.title: Top Services
services.top_services.insight: Which services bring in the most money.

services.avg_ticket.title: Average Service Ticket
services.avg_ticket.insight: What a typical service job is worth.

services.jobs_count.title: Jobs Completed
services.jobs_count.insight: How many service jobs you finished in the period.

customers.new.title: New Customers

customers.new_trend.title: New Customer Trend
customers.new_trend.insight: First-time buyers plotted across the period.

customers.active.title: Active Customers
customers.active.insight: Customers who actually bought something in the period.

customers.dormant.title: Dormant Customers
customers.dormant.insight: Regulars who have gone quiet — the cheapest sales list you own.

customers.repeat_rate.title: Repeat Customer Rate
customers.repeat_rate.insight: What share of sales came from people who had bought before.

customers.top_customers.title: Top Customers
customers.top_customers.insight: Who spends the most with you.

customers.avg_spend.title: Average Customer Spend
customers.avg_spend.insight: What a typical customer is worth in the period.

customers.owing.title: Customers Who Owe You
customers.owing.insight: Every customer with a balance, largest first.

customers.by_area.title: Customers by Area
customers.by_area.insight: Where your customers are, so you know which area actually pays.

suppliers.active.title: Active Suppliers
suppliers.active.insight: Suppliers you actually bought from in the period.

suppliers.top_suppliers.title: Top Suppliers by Spend
suppliers.top_suppliers.insight: Where your purchase money is going.

suppliers.spend_trend.title: Supplier Spend Trend
suppliers.spend_trend.insight: Purchase spend plotted across the period.

suppliers.owed_list.insight: Your payables broken out per supplier — the list you check before paying anyone.

suppliers.concentration.title: Supplier Concentration
suppliers.concentration.insight: How much of your buying depends on one supplier. High means fragile.

pos.revenue.title: Counter Revenue
pos.revenue.insight: Money taken at the counter in the period.

pos.sale_count.title: Sales Rung Up
pos.sale_count.insight: How many separate sales went through the till.

pos.avg_ticket.title: Average Ticket
pos.avg_ticket.insight: What a typical sale is worth — the number to move if you want growth without more footfall.

pos.items_per_sale.title: Items per Sale
pos.items_per_sale.insight: How many things the average customer walks out with.

pos.payment_breakdown.title: Payment Method Split
pos.payment_breakdown.insight: Cash, card, wallet, credit — how people actually pay you.

pos.hourly_heatmap.insight: Which hours earn and which hours you are paying staff to stand still.

pos.weekday_split.title: Sales by Day of Week
pos.weekday_split.insight: Your week's rhythm, so rosters and stock match reality.

pos.discount_total.insight: How much margin walked out as discount.

pos.live_feed.title: Live Sale Feed
pos.live_feed.insight: The last few sales as they happen.

invoicing.overdue_count.insight: Invoices past their due date. Chase these first.

invoicing.overdue_value.title: Overdue Value

invoicing.avg_invoice.insight: What a typical invoice is worth.

invoicing.largest_open.insight: The biggest unpaid invoices, largest first.

invoicing.draft_count.title: Drafts Waiting to Send
invoicing.draft_count.insight: Invoices written but never sent — money you forgot to ask for.

quotations.open_value.title: Open Quote Value

quotations.win_rate_trend.title: Win Rate Trend
quotations.win_rate_trend.insight: Whether your hit rate is improving or slipping.

quotations.avg_quote.insight: What a typical quote is worth.

quotations.expiring.title: Quotes Expiring Soon
quotations.expiring.insight: Quotes about to lapse — one phone call each.

sales_orders.open_count.insight: Orders accepted but not yet delivered.

sales_orders.value_trend.insight: Order value coming in, day by day — your earliest demand signal.

sales_orders.fulfil_rate.title: Fulfilment Rate
sales_orders.fulfil_rate.insight: What share of orders you delivered complete and on time.

sales_orders.by_customer.title: Open Orders by Customer
sales_orders.by_customer.insight: Who is waiting on you, and for how much.

recurring.active_count.insight: How many customers are on an automatic billing cycle.

recurring.monthly_value.insight: Money you can count on every month without selling again.

recurring.trend.title: Recurring Revenue Trend
recurring.trend.insight: Whether your predictable base is growing.

recurring.due_next_7.title: Due in Next 7 Days
recurring.due_next_7.insight: What is about to bill, so nothing surprises anyone.

recurring.share_of_revenue.insight: How much of the business runs on autopilot.

recurring.churned.title: Cancelled Subscriptions
recurring.churned.insight: Recurring customers who stopped in the period.

proposals.count.title: Proposals Sent

proposals.pipeline_value.title: Proposal Pipeline Value
proposals.pipeline_value.insight: Total value of everything still in play.

proposals.avg_value.title: Average Proposal Value
proposals.avg_value.insight: The size of a typical deal.

proposals.avg_cycle_days.title: Average Sales Cycle
proposals.avg_cycle_days.insight: How many days a deal takes from sent to signed.

pricing.tier_count.insight: How many price levels you actually run.

pricing.customers_by_tier.title: Customers per Tier
pricing.customers_by_tier.insight: How your customer base is spread across tiers.

pricing.discount_vs_list.insight: The gap between your sticker price and reality.

tables.occupancy_rate.insight: What share of your seats earn, across the period.

tables.kitchen_pending.insight: Orders fired but not yet served.

tables.avg_turn_minutes.insight: How long a table takes from seated to cleared.

tables.covers.title: Covers Served
tables.covers.insight: How many people you actually fed.

tables.avg_cover_value.insight: What one diner is worth — the lever for upselling.

tables.revenue_per_table.insight: Which tables earn and which are dead space.

tables.peak_occupancy.insight: When the floor fills, hour by hour.

presales.pending_delivery.title: Awaiting Delivery

inventory.days_of_cover.title: Days of Stock Cover

inventory.value_by_category.insight: Where your stock money actually sits.

inventory.top_by_value.title: Biggest Stock Holdings
inventory.top_by_value.insight: The items tying up the most cash.

locations.revenue_by_location.title: Revenue by Location

locations.stock_by_location.insight: Where your inventory money is parked.

transfers.discrepancy_count.insight: Moves where what arrived did not match what was sent.

variants.top_variants.insight: Which exact size and colour sells — not just which product.

variants.slow_variants.insight: The sizes and colours that always get left behind.

variants.out_of_stock.title: Variants Out of Stock
variants.out_of_stock.insight: Gaps in your size or colour run.

variants.size_colour_mix.insight: How demand splits across your run, so next order matches reality.

barcodes.coverage_pct.insight: What share of your catalogue can be scanned.

uom.sales_by_uom.insight: How much you move in each unit — kilos, pieces, cartons.

uom.missing_conversion.insight: Items that will cost you wrong until a conversion is set.
